target_customer: Specialty medical groups with roughly 20 to 500 physicians
problem: Practices spend staff time on prior authorizations, intake, scheduling and call triage.
business_model: B2B SaaS selling AI voice and workflow agents to medical groups

founders.name: Tej Seelamsetty
education: WashU, computer science and financial engineering
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: began flipping houses at 18, led growth at Fair Square (W20).

founders.name: Aumesh Misra
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: 8th engineer at Compound; earlier worked on medical imaging device software at Stanford.

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM agents for prior authorization and voice calls need payer portal automation and HIPAA handling, standard but fiddly for two founders.

defensibility.rationale: Integration with practice systems adds some stickiness; many voice AI vendors target the same buyers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Healthcare voice AI vendors competed directly; sources listing them were undated, so timing is not verified.

market_need_then: Administrative load in specialty practices is the stated pain; named customers included Los Angeles Cancer Network per a 2026 report.

identity.visual_style: Healthcare AI marketing site; a freelancer portfolio shows a website UI design project

brand_strength.rationale: Brand coverage is limited to funding press and a YC launch post with emoji in the title.

pivots.to: Voice AI agents for intake, scheduling and call triage
pivots.why: Not stated; product descriptions differ between the YC page and 2026 press

outcome_analysis: Tivara shows an active company with a 3.6 million dollar seed in January 2026 even though YC lists it as inactive. It moved from prior authorization toward voice agents in a crowded category. The outcome is unresolved and the inactive flag conflicts with 2026 press.
notes: Pre-seed rests on a single aggregator (Extruct) and the April 2025 seed with Caplight, which also reports 4.6M total; amount of that round unknown so a gap exists. YC status Inactive conflicts with January 2026 funding. Website returned HTTP 403. No competitor source dated near the Summer 2024 batch was found, so the list is empty.
